product.olivetti-p800.summary: The Micro Channel system with a 25 MHz 386, 64 KB cache and ESDI disks.
product.olivetti-p800.history: The Olivetti service guide documents P800 (the Micro Channel system with a 25 MHz 386, 64 KB cache and ESDI disks).
product.olivetti-p800.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA826 · 82C451 · ESDI.
product.olivetti-p800.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.07.
product.olivetti-p800.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-p800.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
